newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediaset firms in Milan on Senate TV decree.
newsitem.headline: Mediaset firms in Milan on Senate TV decree.

text.p: Italian television and advertising group Mediaset rose sharply on the Milan bourse after the upper house Senate approved a decree extending current laws of TV ownership until end-January 1997.

Without the move, magistrates could have forced former prime minister Silvio Berlusconi to take one of the three stations he controls off the air. The decree now moves to the lower Chamber of Deputies.
"We can now look at the whole question of settling the TV question with more optimism," one trader said.
At 1540 GMT, Mediaset shares were up 4.95 percent at 7,360 lire ($4.86) after a high of 7,390 in high volume of 4.4 million shares.
